readme:
Play Integrity Alert

## About this module **Play Integrity Alert notifies you the moment an app asks for a Google Play Integrity verdict.** Scope the module to Google Play Store, choose which apps you care about (or watch them all), and whenever one of them calls the Play Integrity API you get a notification — with the app's name — plus an in-app history of every detection. The Play Integrity client libraries don't compute a verdict in-process; they hand the request to **Google Play Store** (`com.android.vending`, "Finsky"), and the caller's package travels *inside* that request. So the module injects into the **Play Store process only** and observes the integrity requests as they arrive — it never alters the verdict, it only tells you it happened. This module behaves just like the [GrapheneOS Play Integrity alert](https://x.com/GrapheneOS/status/1877790719009529972) feature, and is inspired by it. ## Usage 1. Install the APK and **enable Play Integrity Alert** in LSPosed. 2. Open the module's **Scope** and tick **Google Play Store** (`com.android.vending`) — that's the only app you need. It's a system app, so if you don't see it, enable **Show system apps** from the scope screen's ⋮ menu and refresh. 3. **Restart Play Store** so the hook loads (the app has a button for this; with root it's automatic). ## Source & documentation Full source, build instructions, and issue tracker live in the upstream repository: **https://github.com/Xiddoc/PlayIntegrityAlert**
readmeZh:
播放完整性警报

## 关于本模块 **当应用程序请求 Google Play 时，Play 完整性警报会通知您 诚信判决。** 将模块范围限定为 Google Play 商店，选择您关心的应用程序（或观看 全部），每当其中一个调用 Play Integrity API 时，您都会得到一个 通知 - 带有应用程序的名称 - 以及每次检测的应用程序内历史记录。 Play Integrity 客户端库不会在处理过程中计算判决；他们手 对 **Google Play Store**（`com.android.vending`、“Finsky”）的请求，以及 呼叫者的包裹在该请求*内部*传送。所以该模块注入 **仅 Play 商店处理**并在完整性请求到达时观察它们 — 它永远不会改变判决，它只是告诉你它发生了。 该模块的行为就像 [GrapheneOS 播放完整性警报](https://x.com/GrapheneOS/status/1877790719009529972) 功能，并受到其启发。 ## 用法 1. 安装 APK 并在 LSPod 中**启用 Play Integrity Alert**。 2. 打开模块的 **Scope** 并勾选 **Google Play Store** (`com.android.vending`) — 这是您唯一需要的应用程序。这是一个系统应用程序，因此如果您没有看到它，请启用 **从示波器屏幕的 ⋮ 菜单显示系统应用程序**并刷新。 3. **重新启动 Play 商店**，以便加载挂钩（应用程序有一个用于此操作的按钮；使用 root 它是自动的）。 ## 来源和文档 完整源代码、构建说明和问题跟踪器位于上游存储库中： **https://github.com/Xiddoc/PlayIntegrityAlert**
